profile.name: Henry Zhang
profile.eyebrow: Software engineer · AI systems · Technical program leadership
profile.headline: I build production AI systems and lead complex technical programs from ambiguity to delivery.
profile.bio: I'm a software engineer at the U.S. Department of the Treasury and a Computer Science and Business graduate from NYU Shanghai. My work spans production AI, data platforms, cloud migrations, full-stack products, and technical program leadership. I am strongest where engineering depth and cross-functional execution meet: translating real operational problems into reliable systems, measurable outcomes, and clear delivery plans.
profile.personalNote: I've studied and worked across the United States, China, and the Middle East, and I am comfortable adapting quickly to new teams, cultures, and expectations. I enjoy experimenting with AI and web development, mentoring others, lifting weights, running, basketball, and lacrosse. I am fluent in Chinese.
profile.welcome: Welcome to my site. Explore the AI systems, data products, cloud programs, and teams I have helped move forward.

projects.title: Inyo
projects.description: An AI-powered SMS matchmaking platform built and launched for thousands of users.
projects.impact: Architected the event-driven backend, AI conversation and profile-extraction pipelines, admin tooling, and production infrastructure.

Balanced scalability, reliability, and execution speed while rapidly delivering the product as a part-time founding engineer and technical lead.

Established a foundation for future product development and client onboarding.

projects.title: Fine-Tuning and Supervised Learning for Stock Prediction
projects.description: Fine-tuned LLaMA 3.1 on financial news with qLoRA and incorporated the enhanced sentiment signal into a time-series stock-prediction model.
projects.impact: Improved financial-news sentiment labeling accuracy by 9%, from 0.75 to 0.84, then used those scores as an additional model feature for market-trend prediction.
highlights: Built the end-to-end research pipeline covering data preparation, parameter-efficient model adaptation, feature generation, and downstream evaluation.

projects.impact: Contributed across design, implementation, and iteration while helping define user stories, scope features, and prioritize the backlog.

projects.title: Resume Portfolio
projects.description: This website, coded from scratch to present my experience, projects, and evolving work across engineering and technical leadership.
projects.impact: Rebuilt the original MERN-era portfolio as a routed React application with reusable content components, an authenticated editor, and DynamoDB-backed publishing.

projects.title: Natural Language to Database Communication
projects.description: A LangChain-based chatbot that enabled natural-language communication with relational databases and generated reports for non-technical users.
projects.impact: Designed the schema-aware prompt and agent flow, built a React widget and REST integration, and made generated queries and reports easier to understand and validate.

projects.title: Airline Flight Booking Simulator
projects.description: A relational flight-booking application with authentication and distinct workflows for customers, airline staff, and agents.
projects.impact: Modeled shared booking data, permissions, CRUD flows, and relational constraints in a Django and MySQL application.

experience.description: Builds production AI, data, and integration systems for high-impact government workflows while partnering with senior leaders and engineering stakeholders to turn manual processes into secure, scalable tools.
highlights: Architected an event-driven mailbox-triage system on AWS with webhook ingestion, failure reconciliation, AI classification, and information extraction, saving approximately 10 staff-hours per week while automating leadership reporting.

Unified approximately 20,000 financial records each week across disparate sources using entity deduplication and a shared ontology, then built graph-based relationship models to surface suspicious transactions and hidden entity connections.

Scoped, built, and productionized an AI security evaluation platform supporting the White House-launched Gold Eagle initiative, with success metrics, a reporting portal, standardized benchmarks, isolated Docker sandboxes, and parallel GCP VMs for reproducible exploitability testing.

Built a Microsoft Graph-backed MCP integration for Treasury's internal ChatGPT ecosystem with per-user authentication, data isolation, and throttling under a four-request-per-second service constraint for more than 4,000 staff.

experience.description: Owned core PMO operations for the organization's largest on-premises-to-AWS migration and paired program leadership with hands-on product and automation work.
highlights: Coordinated more than 60 application teams across the U.S., U.K., Singapore, and India through roadmap planning, migration-wave sequencing, milestone tracking, and cross-functional execution, achieving migration readiness within six months.

Maintained program status, dependency, risk, and technical-decision records; surfaced application dependencies, security approvals, environment-readiness gaps, and infrastructure tradeoffs before migration waves, then coordinated Engineering, DevOps, security, and client owners to keep delivery on schedule.

Built a full-stack AI program-management platform that automated metrics from Excel trackers and used LLMs to extract risks, blockers, goals, and status updates from meeting notes, reducing executive and quarterly reporting turnaround from as long as one week to on-demand access.

Translated fragmented operational workflows into structured system requirements, a normalized data model, and automation rules that standardized project initiation, tracking, and cross-team visibility across projects and clients.

experience.description: Built and evaluated retrieval, analytics, and product experiences over more than 40,000 medical records where accuracy, coverage, relevance, and trustworthiness were critical.
highlights: Built a retrieval-augmented data pipeline combining embedding similarity with keyword filtering, generating vector embeddings and semantic-search indexes with AWS EC2, PostgreSQL, and PGvector.
Optimized PostgreSQL hybrid search by filtering candidates with full-text search before PGvector ranking and reducing unnecessary joins and intermediate data transfer.

Established a reusable evaluation framework using precision, recall, and AI-assisted relevance scoring to compare models, retrieval configurations, and top-k results; translated ambiguous product, engineering, and medical-data asks into success criteria and representative test cases.

Applied AI models to identify and categorize relevant clinical information, then used Pendo analytics to find usability pain points and implemented React data-visualization improvements with product and design, translating insights into prioritized Jira work.

experience.description: Built enterprise AI prototypes and helped clients evaluate whether AI and Azure opportunities were technically feasible, commercially useful, and ready for implementation.
highlights: Developed an enterprise LLM chatbot with embeddings, prompt engineering, and agent workflows for natural-language querying across internal datasets, cutting project-management reporting cycles from weeks to days.
Built a React frontend widget and REST API service to integrate the system into an internal portal used by project managers and stakeholders.
Translated business needs into scoped Azure and machine-learning pilots with defined data requirements, feasibility criteria, and implementation tradeoffs to accelerate go/no-go decisions.
Supported a computer-vision pilot for ballet-pose classification by preparing labeled data and evaluating machine-learning approaches.

experience.description: Worked directly with the technical lead at an early-stage investment-trading platform on data infrastructure, implementation decisions, analytics, and market expansion.
highlights: Evaluated infrastructure options by balancing cost, implementation effort, integration complexity, and performance to inform architectural decisions.
Designed a relational schema and wrote SQL scripts to extract, transform, and load JSON user analytics from MongoDB into BigQuery.
Conducted outreach to U.S. universities, assessed expansion opportunities, and delivered a go-to-market plan for adoption on college campuses.
